## Warning: package 'cowplot' was built under R version 4.2.3
clockor_4 <- read.csv("clockor4.csv", sep = ",")
clockor_4$date <- as.numeric(clockor_4$decimal.date)
clockor_4$distance <- as.numeric(clockor_4$root.to.tip.distance)
clockor_4$group <- as.factor((clockor_4$group))

#linear regression of root-to-tip global
mod4general <- lm(distance ~ date, data=clockor_4[clockor_4$group=="Global",])
summary(mod4general)
## 
## Call:
## lm(formula = distance ~ date, data = clockor_4[clockor_4$group == 
##     "Global", ])
## 
## Residuals:
##        Min         1Q     Median         3Q        Max 
## -0.0027632 -0.0006105 -0.0001168  0.0007553  0.0022216 
## 
## Coefficients:
##               Estimate Std. Error t value Pr(>|t|)    
## (Intercept) -1.574e+00  5.433e-02  -28.98   <2e-16 ***
## date         8.439e-04  2.692e-05   31.35   <2e-16 ***
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
## 
## Residual standard error: 0.00105 on 76 degrees of freedom
## Multiple R-squared:  0.9282, Adjusted R-squared:  0.9273 
## F-statistic: 982.7 on 1 and 76 DF,  p-value: < 2.2e-16
sigma(mod4general)
## [1] 0.001049595

#clockor of PIV4 tree - root to tip - COMPLETE

  geom_point(shape=21, size=2) + 
  theme_classic() + 
  scale_x_continuous(name="Time", limits=c(1800, 2025), breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 10)) +
  scale_y_continuous(name="Root-to-tip (subst/site)", limits=c(0, 0.15)) +
  geom_abline(aes(intercept=-1.574,slope=0.0008439), linetype=2, color="black") +
  geom_abline(aes(intercept=-1.649,slope=0.0008808), linetype=2, color="yellow") +
  geom_abline(aes(intercept=-1.435,slope=0.0007746), linetype=2, color="violet") +
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("yellow", "violet", "gray"))
root2tip_piv4_complete

## Warning: Removed 1 row containing missing values or values outside the scale range
## (`geom_segment()`).

library("rstatix")
## 
## Attaching package: 'rstatix'
## The following object is masked from 'package:stats':
## 
##     filter
library("ggforce")
## Warning: package 'ggforce' was built under R version 4.2.3
pivdemog <- read_excel("SupplementaryTable1.xlsx")
pivdemog$subgroup <- as.factor(pivdemog$Virus)
pivdemog$sex <- as.factor(pivdemog$Sex)
pivdemog$PIV <- as.factor(substr(pivdemog$Virus, 1, 6))
pivdemog$age_at_collection <- ifelse(
        pivdemog$Longitudinal_sample == "no",
        suppressWarnings(as.numeric(pivdemog$Age)),
        NA_real_
        )

pivdemog_clean <- pivdemog %>%
  filter(!is.na(age_at_collection) & !is.na(sex))

ggplot(data = pivdemog_clean, mapping=aes(x=PIV, y=age_at_collection)) +  geom_violin() + geom_boxplot(width=.1) + geom_sina()

pivdemog_clean %>% group_by(PIV) %>% get_summary_stats(age_at_collection, type="median")
## # A tibble: 2 × 4
##   PIV    variable              n median
##   <fct>  <fct>             <dbl>  <dbl>
## 1 HPIV-2 age_at_collection    49    8  
## 2 HPIV-4 age_at_collection    36   55.5
wilcox.test(age_at_collection ~ PIV, data=pivdemog_clean)
## Warning in wilcox.test.default(x = DATA[[1L]], y = DATA[[2L]], ...): cannot
## compute exact p-value with ties
## 
##  Wilcoxon rank sum test with continuity correction
## 
## data:  age_at_collection by PIV
## W = 492.5, p-value = 0.0005235
## alternative hypothesis: true location shift is not equal to 0
ggplot(data = pivdemog_clean, mapping=aes(x=subgroup, y=age_at_collection)) +  geom_violin() + geom_boxplot(width=.1) + geom_sina()

pivdemog_clean %>% group_by(subgroup) %>% get_summary_stats(age_at_collection, type="median")
## # A tibble: 3 × 4
##   subgroup variable              n median
##   <fct>    <fct>             <dbl>  <dbl>
## 1 HPIV-2   age_at_collection    49      8
## 2 HPIV-4a  age_at_collection    17     56
## 3 HPIV-4b  age_at_collection    19     55
pairwise.wilcox.test(pivdemog_clean$age_at_collection, pivdemog_clean$subgroup, p.adjust.method = "BH")
## Warning in wilcox.test.default(xi, xj, paired = paired, ...): cannot compute
## exact p-value with ties
## Warning in wilcox.test.default(xi, xj, paired = paired, ...): cannot compute
## exact p-value with ties
## Warning in wilcox.test.default(xi, xj, paired = paired, ...): cannot compute
## exact p-value with ties
## 
##  Pairwise comparisons using Wilcoxon rank sum test with continuity correction 
## 
## data:  pivdemog_clean$age_at_collection and pivdemog_clean$subgroup 
## 
##         HPIV-2 HPIV-4a
## HPIV-4a 0.01   -      
## HPIV-4b 0.01   0.57   
## 
## P value adjustment method: BH
table(pivdemog_clean$subgroup, pivdemog_clean$sex)
##          
##            F  M NA
##   HPIV-2  13 36  0
##   HPIV-4a  8  9  0
##   HPIV-4b  6 13  0
table(pivdemog_clean$subgroup, pivdemog_clean$sex)
##          
##            F  M NA
##   HPIV-2  13 36  0
##   HPIV-4a  8  9  0
##   HPIV-4b  6 13  0
fisher.test(table(pivdemog_clean$subgroup, pivdemog_clean$sex))
## 
##  Fisher's Exact Test for Count Data
## 
## data:  table(pivdemog_clean$subgroup, pivdemog_clean$sex)
## p-value = 0.314
## alternative hypothesis: two.sided
piv24season <- read_excel("hpiv_subtyped_rate.xlsx")
piv24season$week <- as.Date(piv24season$week, "%Y-%m-%d")
## Warning in as.POSIXlt.POSIXct(x, tz = tz): unknown timezone '%Y-%m-%d'
piv24season$subtype <- as.factor(piv24season$subtype)
piv24season$pivrate <- as.numeric(piv24season$pivrate)
piv24season$total <- as.numeric(piv24season$total)
piv24season$pos <- as.numeric(piv24season$pos)


piv24_seasonality <- ggplot(data = piv24season) + theme_classic() + geom_area(mapping=aes(x=week, y=total / 100), fill="lightgray") + geom_col(mapping=aes(x=week, y=pivrate, fill=subtype), position = "dodge") + scale_y_continuous(name="Percentage of positive cases (%)",sec.axis = sec_axis(~.*100, name= "Total number of tested samples")) + xlab("") + scale_x_date(expand=c(0,0), date_breaks = "2 months") + theme(axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 10, angle = 45, colour = "black", vjust = 1, hjust = 1))

piv24_cases <- ggplot(data = piv24season) + theme_classic() + geom_area(mapping=aes(x=week, y=total / 50), fill="lightgray") + geom_col(mapping=aes(x=week, y=pos, fill=subtype), position = "dodge") + scale_y_continuous(name="Total number of positive cases (%)",sec.axis = sec_axis(~.*100, name= "Total number of tested samples")) + xlab("") + scale_x_date(expand=c(0,0), date_breaks = "2 months") + theme(axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 10, angle = 45, colour = "black", vjust = 1, hjust = 1))

piv24_seasonality

piv24_cases

library(forcats)
list_4A_vs_rubula_blosum62 <- read_excel("list_4A-vs-rubula_blosum62.xlsx", col_types = c("text", "numeric", "text"))

piv4A_vs_rubula <- list_4A_vs_rubula_blosum62 %>% 
    mutate(VIRUS = factor(VIRUS, levels=c("HPIV-4B", "Wufeng Rhinolophus sinicus rubulavirus 1", "Eptesicus fuscus orthorubulavirus", "La Piedad Michoacan Mexico virus", "Mapuera virus", "Mumps virus", "Bat Paramyxovirus", "HPIV-2", "Rousettus bat paramyxovirus", "Simian virus 41", "Alston virus", "Parainfluenza virus 5 (SV5)", "Achimota virus 1", "Achimota virus 2", "Achimota pararubulavirus 3", "Menangle virus", "Teviot virus", "Tioman virus", "Tuhoko virus 1", "Tuhoko virus 2", "Tuhoko virus 3", "Sosuga virus"))) %>% 
    ggplot(aes(x=VIRUS, y=DIST, color=GENE, group=GENE)) +geom_point(size=2.5) + geom_line(linewidth=1) + theme_classic() + theme(axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 10, angle = 45, colour = "black", vjust = 1, hjust = 1)) + scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 100), breaks = seq(0, 100, by = 20)) +
  ggtitle("Amino acid pairwise similarity (%) from HPIV-4A") + theme(axis.text.x=element_text(size=15), axis.text.y=element_text(size=15), plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size=20)) + ylab("") + xlab("") + 
  scale_color_manual(values=c("#56B4E9", "orange", "red", "blue", "lightgreen", "violet"))

piv4A_vs_rubula
